title: SAVA Gelaro SF6 tire compatibility FAQ recheck
notes: The exact-model manufacturer FAQ says the bike is supplied with 700×40C tires and is compatible with tires up to 45C. Treat 45C as a nominal tire-size compatibility claim, not measured casing width or physical frame/fork clearance. The page offers both R21-U6020 10-speed and R21-U6000 11-speed options, so the candidate's exact complete-build identity remains unresolved.
